# Dovetail

Dovetail is an Australian software company that provides tools for transcription analysis, coding interpretation of interviews, survey responses, and feedback, enabling users to create summarized insights from their research analysis.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/dovetail/.

## Actions

- **Create Channel**: Create a new channel in dovetail.
- **Create Contact**: Create a new contact in dovetail.
- **Create Data Point**: Create a data point within a channel.
- **Create Insight**: Create a new insight in dovetail.
- **Create Topic**: Create a new topic in a channel.
- **Delete Channel**: Delete an existing channel.
- **Delete Topic**: Delete an existing topic.
- **Get Note**: Retrieve details of a specific note.
- **Get Token Info**: Get information about the current api token.
- **List Contacts**: List all contacts in dovetail.
- **List Data**: List data items in dovetail.
- **List Highlights**: List all highlights in dovetail.
- **List Notes**: List all notes in dovetail.
- **List Projects**: List all projects in dovetail.
- **List Tags**: List all tags in dovetail.
- **List User Insights**: List insights for a specific user.
- **Magic Search**: Perform a magic search across workspace data.
- **Update Topic**: Update an existing topic.
